title: CTO, IBM Skills Network
headline: CTO, IBM Skills Network. Helping leading organizations upskill employees in the latest technologies.
summary:
I am a serial Intrepreneur with a number of very successful projects to my credit. My responsibility is to push frontiers of technology to create next generation products to help people develop skills in the area of AI, Data Science, Cloud-native Development, DevOps, Data Engineering Big Data, Data Analytics, Cybersecurity and more. A technologist at heart, I focus on value creation using technology rather than technology itself. I am a relentless pursuer of product-market fit. As a Definite Optimist I believe in envisioning the future, and, since vision without a plan is a hallucination, I like to map out a path to achieving the goal. I am motivated by grand visions, hugely ambitious goals and barely possible challenges.

I prefer small purpose-driven teams. I believe that building the right team is even more important than building the right product. I am honoured to have assembled and lead what I consider to be the best team in the industry. Young, smart, united by a common purpose the team has demonstrated their ability to overcome the toughest obstacles and go toe-to-toe with the best venture funded startups.

I also advise a number of promising startups. It is something that I enjoy as it helps me apply my experience towards helping the next generation of entrepreneurs.

Specialties: AI, Database systems, Big Data, Data Science and Cloud Computing.

profile_positions.title: Director & CTO, IBM Skills Network
profile_positions.description:
Developer Advocacy and Engagement: Cultivating the current and next generation developer community. Driving awareness, consideration, preference and loyalty within developer community.

Incubating next generation mobile and cloud projects in the area of information management and analytics. Keeping an eye on emerging technology and development processes for IBM product teams.
